# Oxford Realty Advisors — Firm Facts (manually curated)

This file is concatenated into the chat assistant's knowledge base at build time. It contains canonical firm-level facts that may not be repeated on every public web page.

## Identity
Oxford Realty Advisors (ORA) is a private family office that owns and operates approximately 500,000 square feet of shallow-bay Class B/C industrial and flex real estate. ORA invests proprietary family capital — there is no outside fund, no LP base, and no committee. Holding philosophy is generational; ORA does not flip assets.

## Leadership
- **Eric Goldberg** — Founder and Principal. Active investor with two decades of operating experience.
- **Gabriel Goldberg** — VP Acquisitions and co-Principal. Leads sourcing and underwriting.

## Markets
ORA acquires and operates in three core markets:
- Maryland (Mid-Atlantic anchor — Baltimore/Columbia/Easton/Salisbury)
- Columbus, Ohio
- Kansas City, Missouri (including Raytown submarket)

ORA is also actively evaluating expansion into growing major Mid-Atlantic and Midwest markets — no current holdings outside the three core markets above. ORA does not actively pursue West Coast, Sun Belt-only, or coastal-California markets.

## Target Deal Parameters
- **Check size:** $1M–$10M equity per deal
- **Asset size:** sub-50,000 SF preferred
- **Asset type:** Class B/C shallow-bay industrial, flex/industrial, light-industrial, occasionally industrial-adjacent retail
- **Clear height:** 18'+ preferred
- **Capital:** 100% proprietary family capital, all-cash to close
- **Speed:** 30-day close standard, no financing contingency
- **Leverage:** Conservative — 40% LTV maximum, historically 14–16% LTV
- **Underwriting:** DSCR ≥ 1.25x; basis below replacement cost; demonstrable margin of safety

## Capital Structure & Partner Posture
ORA is **not** currently raising outside capital. We invest exclusively from family balance sheet. Institutional partners interested in being on the radar for future opportunities may reach out, but there is no fund or syndicate offering at this time.

## Track Record
- 500,000+ SF currently under management
- 140+ tenants across the portfolio
- Founded 2005 (advisory practice); shifted to direct ownership in 2008
- Entered Columbus, OH in 2021 with the Sepich Portfolio acquisition (110K SF)
- Surpassed 400K SF in 2022; expanded into Kansas City in 2024

## How to Engage
- **Brokers with off-market industrial/flex deals fitting our parameters:** submit OM and rent roll at oxfordra.net/for-brokers, or reach out to Gabriel directly.
- **Prospective tenants:** browse current vacancies at oxfordra.net/available-space; submit a lease application at oxfordra.net/tenant-application.
- **Existing tenants:** email maintenance@oxfordra.net for service requests; for billing or lease questions, reach the office directly.
- **General inquiries:** info@oxfordra.net or 301.512.6125.
- **Direct to Gabriel:** ggoldberg@oxfordra.net
- **Direct to Eric:** egoldberg@oxfordra.net
- **Office:** 9510 Persimmon Tree Road, Suite 200, Potomac, MD 20854

## What ORA Does Not Discuss Publicly
- Specific tenant names, lease terms, or rent levels on individual assets
- AUM figures beyond the publicly stated ~500K SF and the implied valuation range
- Specific deal pricing, NOI, cap rates, or returns on individual properties
- Pending acquisitions, dispositions, LOIs, or pipeline
- Lender names, transaction counsel, or vendor relationships
- Information about other tenants or properties not on the public website

For any of the above, the answer is to refer the visitor to Gabriel directly.

About Oxford Realty Advisors

A Private Investment Firm Built for Generations












The Firm
Oxford Realty Advisors




Founded in 2005, Oxford began as a commercial real estate advisory practice before recognizing the greatest opportunity lay in owning. Today we are a principal investor and operator with 500,000+ SF of shallow-bay industrial and flex space across three core markets — acquired with 100% family capital, no outside investors, and no fund structure.

We target the structural undersupply of functional Class B/C industrial space in secondary markets, acquiring what institutional buyers avoid: high-vacancy assets with deferred maintenance, environmental complexity, or fractured ownership. Below-market leases reset at expiry, occupancy climbs through active management, and proceeds recycle into accretive acquisitions. A 15% portfolio LTV means all-cash closings on every deal — and the ability to hold through any cycle.

Team
Leadership







Eric Goldberg

Founder

Eric Goldberg founded Oxford Realty Advisors in 2005 after a career in commercial real estate advisory and accounting. A graduate of Washington University in St. Louis with a degree in Accounting, Eric has built Oxford into a vertically integrated owner-operator of industrial and flex properties across multiple markets. His investment philosophy centers on acquiring functional industrial assets at a basis that provides a margin of safety against downside risk while positioning for long-term compounding through operational improvements and rent resets.








Gabriel Goldberg

Vice President, Acquisitions

Gabriel Goldberg leads Oxford's acquisition pipeline, from deal sourcing and underwriting to negotiation and closing. A graduate of Cornell University with a degree in Economics, Gabriel manages relationships with the firm's broker network, oversees due diligence for all new acquisitions, and is building the technology infrastructure to scale Oxford's operations.
















Extended Team
Our Network

Oxford operates with a lean core team backed by specialized partners in every discipline.









Transaction Counsel

Dedicated CRE attorneys managing PSA negotiation, title review, entity structuring, and closing coordination.








Accounting & Tax

CPA firm handling entity-level reporting, cost segregation studies, 1031 exchanges, and multi-state tax compliance.








Property Management

Market-local PMs handling leasing, maintenance, collections, and tenant relations across all three core markets.








Environmental & Diligence

Phase I/II environmental consultants, PCA inspectors, and survey firms engaged on every acquisition.














Relationships
What Our Partners Say

Built on Relationships












“
I've worked with Oxford for about 13 years and we've completed half a dozen transactions together. They consistently perform as capable buyers. When the opportunity is right, they overlook small problems and keep the bigger picture in mind. They've been on the broker side before, so they know the importance of trust and do not waste my time. Professional, easy to work with, and very responsive.




Nathan Pealer
Managing Director Investments — Marcus & Millichap







“
Oxford Realty operates in a highly professional fashion. Leasing, management, and asset care are taken in a balanced approach to achieve highly productive properties. Working with Oxford has been a pleasure for all these many years.




Carl Truitt
Property Manager







“
From day one it has felt more like a partnership than a typical owner/manager relationship. They are always available and very involved — fair, willing to spend money when needed, and always thinking long term.




Paul Trautman
KRG Real Estate







“
Eric and Gabriel are wonderful to work with. They are reasonable in their dealings with prospective tenants, are very responsive, and are always willing to make repairs to newly vacant spaces as necessary.




Terry Declerq
Miller & Diversified







“
We would not be in business without Mr. Goldberg. Several years ago we had a very difficult period and Eric listened to our situation and worked out a plan that helped us get back on our feet. He always does what he says he will.




Azad Shah
Tenant





























FAQ
Common Questions







When was Oxford Realty Advisors founded?




Oxford Realty Advisors was founded in 2005 and has operated as a principal investor and operator in industrial real estate for over 21 years.










Is Oxford a real estate fund?




No. Oxford is a private, family-owned operating company, not a fund. There are no outside limited partners, no capital calls, and no fund-life exit deadline driving acquisition or disposition decisions.










What is Oxford’s investment strategy?




Oxford targets the structural undersupply of functional Class B/C industrial space in secondary markets, acquiring below replacement cost and driving returns through active, hands-on management rather than financial engineering.










How is Oxford capitalized?




Oxford acquires with 100% proprietary family capital. A conservative 15% portfolio loan-to-value means every acquisition closes all-cash, without financing contingencies or lender approval timelines.










Who makes acquisition decisions at Oxford?




Oxford operates without an investment committee. Acquisition decisions are made directly by the firm’s principals, which is why brokers and sellers get a definitive answer in days, not weeks.

For Brokers
Partner With Oxford

— Broker-first. Relationship-driven. No exceptions.

One call. One decision-maker. All-cash closings in 30–45 days.











Why Oxford
A Broker's Ideal Counterparty

Oxford invests 100% family capital — no outside investors, no fund structure, no committee. We close all-cash in 30–45 days from LOI, carry a 15% portfolio LTV, and are comfortable with vacancy, deferred maintenance, and environmental complexity. One call, one decision-maker, no financing contingency. Proof of funds available on request.

Submit a deal below and receive a graded investment score based on our 100-parameter acquisition scorecard.

Strategy
Value-Add, Long-Term Hold



Acquisition Basis
Significantly below replacement cost



Complexity Tolerance
Vacancy, deferred maintenance, environmental & legal issues













Certainty of Close
Your Deal Doesn’t Have to Die at Financing




Most buyers using debt lose deals they have already negotiated. Lender requirements on occupancy, environmental status, lease term, and property condition kill transactions that are fundamentally sound. Oxford operates without those constraints.


No financing contingency

No appraisal contingency

No minimum occupancy requirement

No lender property condition threshold

No agency environmental exclusions


If the numbers work on intrinsic basis, we close. That is the deal we want from you.












Own a Building?
Thinking About Selling Your Industrial Property?

If you own an industrial or flex building and are weighing a sale, you can come to us directly. Oxford buys for its own account with 100% family capital — no financing contingency, no wholesaler assigning your contract, a straightforward all-cash close.


Get an Offer
Read Our Seller Guides













Incentives
Benefits of Working With Oxford

We reward the brokers who bring us deals










Investment Participation Program

Co-invest alongside Oxford on the deals you bring us. Earn equity upside beyond your commission — aligned incentives for long-term partnership.









Buyside Compensation Incentive

Competitive buyside commission on every closed transaction. Fast payment — no waiting on lender funding or escrow holdbacks. Your check cuts at closing.









Commission Protection Pledge

Your commission is protected regardless of deal structure changes during due diligence. If we close, you get paid — no retrading, no renegotiation of broker compensation.















Submit a Deal
Upload OM or Rent Roll

Receive a Graded Investment Score

















FAQ
Common Questions









How quickly can Oxford close?




We routinely close in 30–45 days from LOI execution. Our fastest close was 28 days. Because we use 100% proprietary capital with no financing contingency, there is no lender approval process to slow things down.










What deal sizes does Oxford target?




Our sweet spot is $1M–$10M per transaction. We target Class B/C shallow-bay industrial and flex properties under 50,000 SF per building. Portfolio deals within this range are welcome.










Does Oxford consider properties with environmental issues?




Yes. We have experience acquiring and remediating properties with recognized environmental conditions, including Phase II findings. Environmental complexity often creates pricing dislocation that aligns with our value-add strategy. We evaluate each situation on its merits.










Does Oxford buy vacant or nearly vacant properties?




Yes. Vacancy is one of the primary reasons a financed buyer cannot close — lenders require DSCR coverage that vacant properties cannot generate. Oxford sizes its offer against stabilized potential, not current income. We have acquired buildings at 0% occupancy and leased them up post-close. Vacancy creates basis, and basis drives returns.










Does Oxford require minimum lease terms from existing tenants?




No. Month-to-month tenancy, near-term expirations, and short-term leases reduce a property’s financeable value but not necessarily its intrinsic value. We underwrite the real estate, not just the existing rent roll.










Which markets are you active in?




Our core markets are the DC Metro area (Maryland), Baltimore City, the Eastern Shore of Maryland, Columbus OH, and Kansas City MO. We are actively evaluating expansion into growing major Mid-Atlantic and Midwest markets.










How does Oxford evaluate a deal?




Every submission is run through our proprietary 100-parameter acquisition scorecard covering location, building quality, tenancy, basis vs. replacement cost, and cash flow dynamics. We build a fully dynamic 10-year underwriting model and provide a graded investment score. Expect a response within one business day.





















Direct Contact
Prefer to Talk?

Reach us directly — no gatekeepers, no voicemail trees.

Tell Us What You Need

Fill out the inquiry form below with your space requirements, preferred market, and timeline. The more detail you provide, the better we can match you.




2
We Match You

Our team reviews your needs against available inventory across all Oxford properties. We respond within one business day with options that fit.




3
Tour & Move In

Schedule a walkthrough, finalize lease terms, and move in. Many units are available move-in ready with flexible lease terms from 1–10 years.















Leasing
For Prospective Tenants

Looking for Space?

Oxford owns and operates over 500,000 square feet of industrial, flex, and office space across three markets. Tell us what you need and we'll match you with available units.

Many of our units are available move-in ready with finished office space, drive-in or dock-height doors, paved parking, and updated electrical. Flexible lease terms from 1–10 years. We respond to all inquiries within one business day.


















FAQ
Common Questions







How do I submit a maintenance request?




Email maintenance@oxfordra.net with a description of the issue, or call 301.512.6125 for emergencies. We respond within one business day for routine requests.










How do I apply for a lease?




Complete our online lease application — it takes about 15 minutes and our team responds within 2 business days.










What lease terms does Oxford offer?




Flexible lease terms from 1–10 years, with many units available move-in ready — finished office space, drive-in or dock-height doors, paved parking, and updated electrical.










How quickly will I hear back about a leasing inquiry?




We respond to all leasing inquiries within one business day and review your requirements against available inventory across all Oxford properties.










What types of space does Oxford lease?




Warehouse/industrial, flex/office-warehouse, and retail/storefront space across Maryland, Columbus OH, and Kansas City MO markets, ranging from under 2,000 SF to 25,000+ SF.

— Azad Shah, Oxford Tenant

Performance
Track Record

A selection of investments demonstrating Oxford's approach to value creation through operational intensity, basis discipline, and generational hold periods.










Featured Case Study
3540 E. Fifth Avenue

Columbus, Ohio · 36,000 SF · Industrial




Acquired for $1.3M, this functionally obsolete truck repair facility was repositioned through a ~$1.0M renovation, including a new metal building skin, roof replacement, full asphalt milling and repaving, overhead door replacements, complete office rebuild, and upgraded HVAC systems. The project also addressed environmental challenges, coordinating with the Ohio EPA to implement vapor mitigation systems. Upon completion, we executed a 10-year lease with a global fragrance manufacturer, achieving an approximate 12% going-in cap rate and increasing the property's market value to nearly 2x total project cost.
